    15→    
    16→    private let recoveryStateSubject = CurrentValueSubject<SecureBackupRecoveryState, Never>(.unknown)
    17→    private let keyBackupStateSubject = CurrentValueSubject<SecureBackupKeyBackupState, Never>(.unknown)

    21→    // periphery:ignore - retaining purpose

    28→    var recoveryState: CurrentValuePublisher<SecureBackupRecoveryState, Never> {

    34→    }

    36→    init(encryption: Encryption) {
    37→        self.encryption = encryption
    38→        
    39→        backupStateListenerTaskHandle = encryption.backupStateListener(listener: SDKListener { [weak self] state in
    40→            guard let self else { return }
    41→            
    42→            switch state {
    43→            case .unknown:
    44→                keyBackupStateSubject.send(.unknown)
    45→            case .creating:
    46→                keyBackupStateSubject.send(.enabling)
    47→            case .enabling:
    48→                keyBackupStateSubject.send(.enabling)
    49→            case .resuming:

    51→            case .enabled:
    52→                keyBackupStateSubject.send(.enabled)
    53→            case .downloading:
    54→                keyBackupStateSubject.send(.enabled)
    55→            case .disabling:
    56→                keyBackupStateSubject.send(.disabling)
    57→            }

    61→            if case .unknown = state {
    62→                updateBackupStateFromRemote()
    63→            }
    64→        })

    69→            switch state {
    70→            case .unknown:

    72→            case .enabled:

    94→            return .failure(.failedEnablingBackup)
    95→        }
    96→        
    97→        return .success(())

    99→

   103→        do {
   104→            try await encryption.disableRecovery()

   115→            guard recoveryState.value == .disabled else {
   116→                MXLog.info("Resetting recovery key")
   117→                
   118→                let key = try await encryption.resetRecoveryKey()
   119→                return .success(key)
   120→            }
   121→            
   122→            MXLog.info("Enabling recovery")
   123→            
   124→            var keyUploadErrored = false
   125→            let recoveryKey = try await encryption.enableRecovery(waitForBackupsToUpload: false, passphrase: nil, progressListener: SDKListener { [weak self] state in
   126→                guard let self else { return }
   127→                
   128→                switch state {
   129→                case .starting, .creatingBackup, .creatingRecoveryKey, .backingUp:
   130→                    recoveryStateSubject.send(.settingUp)
   131→                case .done:
   132→                    recoveryStateSubject.send(.enabled)
   133→                case .roomKeyUploadError:
   134→                    MXLog.error("Failed enabling recovery: room key upload error")
   135→                    keyUploadErrored = true
   136→                }
   137→            })
   138→            
   139→            return keyUploadErrored ? .failure(.failedGeneratingRecoveryKey) : .success(recoveryKey)
   140→        } catch {
   141→            MXLog.error("Failed generating recovery key with error: \(error)")
   142→            
   143→            return .failure(.failedGeneratingRecoveryKey)
   144→        }
   145→    }

   148→        do {
   149→            MXLog.info("Confirming recovery key")
   150→            try await encryption.recover(recoveryKey: key)
   151→            return .success(())
   152→        } catch {
   153→            MXLog.info("Failed confirming recovery key with error: \(error)")
   154→            return .failure(.failedConfirmingRecoveryKey)
   155→        }
   156→    }
   157→        
   158→    func waitForKeyBackupUpload(uploadStateSubject: CurrentValueSubject<SecureBackupSteadyState, Never>) async -> Result<Void, SecureBackupControllerError> {
   159→        do {
   160→            MXLog.info("Waiting for backup upload steady state")
   161→            try await encryption.waitForBackupUploadSteadyState(progressListener: SDKListener { state in
   162→                let uploadState: SecureBackupSteadyState = switch state {
   163→                case .waiting: .waiting
   164→                case .uploading(let backedUpCount, let totalCount): .uploading(uploadedKeyCount: Int(backedUpCount), totalKeyCount: Int(totalCount))
   165→                case .error: .error
   166→                case .done: .done
   167→                }
   168→                
   169→                uploadStateSubject.send(uploadState)
   170→            })
   171→            return .success(())
   172→        } catch let error as SteadyStateError {
   173→            MXLog.error("Failed waiting for backup upload steady state with error: \(error)")
   174→            
   175→            switch error {
   176→            case .BackupDisabled:
   177→                MXLog.error("Key backup disabled, continuing logout.")
   178→                return .success(())
   179→            case .Connection, .Lagged:
   180→                MXLog.error("Key backup upload failure: \(error)")
   181→                return .failure(.failedUploadingForBackup)
   182→            }
   183→        } catch {
   184→            MXLog.error("Unknown key backup upload failure")
   185→            return .failure(.failedUploadingForBackup)
   186→        }
   187→    }

   191→    private func updateBackupStateFromRemote(retry: Bool = true) {
   192→        remoteBackupStateTask = Task {
   193→            do {

   195→                let backupExists = try await self.encryption.backupExistsOnServer()

   197→                if Task.isCancelled {

   199→                }

   203→                }
   204→            } catch {
   205→                MXLog.error("Failed retrieving remote backup state with error: \(error)")
   206→                
   207→                if retry {
   208→                    updateBackupStateFromRemote(retry: false)
   209→                }
   210→            }
   211→        }
   212→    }
